listings.company: Caring Transitions of Newtown, PA
listings.description: Welcome Home to CTBids! We put together an excellent selection of items for you! Start exploring and discover the deals for yourself! Bidding on ALL items starts at $1! Please join CT Bids Newtown on the adventure of a lifetime into an elegant collection of African and Asian decor including imported hand carved chests, lamps, decor and more. This is a treasure trove of unique and curated items sure to please! EVERYTHING MUST GO! Browse and bid on unique and everyday treasures at NewtownPA.CTBids.com About Caring Transitions and CTBids: We are carefully managing the treasures and everyday household items for our clients as they downsize or transition to new homes. These items have quality, value, and a history that are a perfect fit for someone else. Our mission was to create a platform where these estate sales are brought to you online. Instead of set pricing, bidding starts at $1. This process allows our bidders to find unique and everyday treasures for a great value. In addition, the repurposing of these belongings will have a positive and lasting impact on the world we all share. CTBids gives us the ability to connect family heirlooms made with yesterday’s craftsmanship with new owners who will give them new LIFE . From unique treasures to everyday items, you will always find something interesting on CTBids! Everyone wins, including the environment! Transitions, by nature, can have profound effects on the environment, and we’re committed to mitigating these impacts. We care about the environment, and the necessity to repurpose household treasures. Caring Transitions is the nation’s largest and most trusted organization specializing in downsizing, relocation, estate sales, decluttering, home cleanouts, online auctions and other services. There are over 325 locations nationwide that are total solution providers for all of life’s transitions. Embrace new beginnings with confidence by learning more on our website . ALL bidders need to register on CTBids, but registration is easy. We look forward to seeing you there! Bidding Just Got Easier! Download our new app in your app store today. Want to be the first to hear about our new sales? Follow us on Facebook ! Overwhelmed by your belongings? Learn more about our services visit our website !

listings.title: Mid-Century Modern Estate Auction - Two Days, Serious Design Collection
listings.company: Easy Transitions 101, LLC
listings.description: This isn't your average estate sale — this is a curated mid-century modern collector's estate, going to auction on-site in Philadelphia's Mount Airy neighborhood, Saturday, August 8th and Sunday, August 9th — preview and registration open at 11:00 AM, with bidding starting at 1:00 PM both days. The collection features named-designer furniture throughout, including a Lane Perception suite (double credenza, record cabinet, side table), an Adrian Pearsall for Craft Associates sectional sofa and coffee table set (tagged), a Paul McCobb Planner Group bench and bar/credenza, a George Nelson for Herman Miller expandable dining table with six chairs, a Sven Ellekaer rosewood and glass coffee table, a France & Son reproduction of the Hans Wegner Papa Bear chair, and a Brutalist two-piece wardrobe. Art and smalls include original Dali lithographs , vintage travel posters (including two by Otto Nielsen), ceramics from Jonathan Adler, Kate Spade, and Orla Kiely , a working vintage mid-century stereo cabinet, a Sohmer piano and bench , hundreds of vintage/rare/first-edition books, vintage vinyl, costume jewelry, and men's and women's clothing. Everything sells to the highest bidder — this is a live, on-site, two-day auction. A 25% buyer's premium applies. Preview photos will be posted ahead of the sale, and online pre-registration is available here: https://Auctions.EasyTransitions101.com Don't miss this one — collections this deep and this well-documented don't come around often.
